newsitem.title: FINLAND: LIPPONEN OUT OF HOSPITAL AFTER HEART TROUBLE.
newsitem.headline: LIPPONEN OUT OF HOSPITAL AFTER HEART TROUBLE.

text.p: Finnish Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen was released from a Copenhagen hospital on Tuesday afternoon after being treated earlier on Tuesday for a heart rhythm problem, the Finnish government said in a statement.

"Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen was being treated today at the Copenhagen central hospital due to a heart rhythm disturbance. Prime Minister Lipponen was released from hospital in the afternoon to return home and he will be back at work on Wednesday," the government said. It gave no further details.
Lipponen was in Denmark to attend a meeting of the Nordic Council in Copenhagen.
An official at the prime minister's office said Lipponen was scheduled to return to Helsinki on a flight due to arrive at 1835 local time (1635 GMT).
